opportunities.title: Move meal and linen carts between hospital departments
opportunities.summary: Carry prepared carts from hospital support areas to wards and return them. Cart compatibility, clean and dirty separation, doors and lifts need an agreed workflow.

reviewLinks.rationale: The manufacturer describes hospital cart pickup and material delivery.
limitations: Prepared compatible carts and commissioned routes are required.
Validate load limits, hygiene segregation, lifts and staff handoff.
